countedBy: lane landmarks-r16-20261123 from the rectified panorama recording_2025-07-14_07-34-51_00639 (2025, frontal, w03-6.alt.jpg, 50 px/m), checked against the 2019 frontal crop (w03-6.jpg); lane landmarks-r17-20261123 recounted it and split the front into its two houses (alongM, metres from the east end; the photo's left is east): they share the facade plane but not their storey heights (the east house's first-floor windows stand 0.5 m above the west house's), so one facade clustered both houses' storeys into the same rows and judged each house's windows off-level against the other's. Glazed openings only, bottom row first. Not yet blind-counted.

facades.name: north (Weteringschans), east house
facades.note: w03-6.alt.jpg x 0-300 px: dark brown brick, three axes of round-headed windows. Basement: two barred lights. Ground storey: the entrance axis (transom light over the panelled door, the aedicule's oculus) and two round-headed windows. Three upper storeys of three.

mixedRows.evidence: w03-6.alt.jpg (recording_2025-07-14_07-34-51_00639, 2025, 50 px/m, h = (1000 - y) * 0.0207 m): the entrance axis carries a transom light over the door (x 42-86, y 867-882 px) and the aedicule's round oculus (x 47-77, y 803-833) where the other two axes have round-headed windows (x 122-178 and 208-265, y 773-905); all four fall in one storey row.

facades.name: north (Weteringschans), west house
facades.note: w03-6.alt.jpg x 300-616 px: red brick with speklagen, three axes of segmental-headed windows, the gable's attic window. Basement: two barred lights under the east and middle axes; the hotel door's glazed upper panel falls in the same row. Ground storey: two windows and the paired round-headed lights of the aedicule over the hotel door. Second and third storeys: French doors with balconies on the middle axis. Fourth storey: three windows.
